data.name: Liorahel
data.gender_notes: Liorahel is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Liorahel is a compound name derived from the Hebrew words 'Lior' (light) and 'Elohim' (God). This name signifies the bearer as a vessel of God's light, shining forth His divine presence and grace. The name Liorahel carries the meaning “Light of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew. Parents who choose Liorahel usually hope their child will grow to embody light of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner light that every person possesses, which is a reflection of God's love and wisdom.
data.etymology: Liorahel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Liorahel total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: ליוֹרָהֵל
in_hebrew.meaning: אלוהים הוא האור שלי, ה' הוא מלכי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ליוֹרָהֵל הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'אלוהים הוא האור שלי' או 'ה' הוא מלכי'. השם מורכב מליוֹר, שפירושו אור, והסיומת אל, שפירושו אלוהים. השם נמצא בשימוש בקרב קהילות יהודיות וגם בקרב נוצרים המשתמשים בשמות עבריים.

in_greek.name: Λιοραχέλ
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι το φως μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Λιοραχέλ είναι εβραϊκής προέλευσης και σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι το φως μου' ή 'Ο Κύριος είναι ο βασιλιάς μου'. Η λέξη Λιορ σημαίνει φως και η κατάληξη Αχέλ σημαίνει Θεός. Το όνομα αυτό έχει ιστορική σημασία στην εβραϊκή παράδοση και χρησιμοποιείται και από χριστιανούς που επιλέγουν εβραϊκά ονόματα.

in_latin.name: Liorahel
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Liorahel origine hebraicum est et significat 'Deus est lux mea' vel 'Dominus est rex meus'. Compositum est ex 'Lior', quod lucem significat, et 'Ahel', quod Deum significat. Hoc nomen in traditione hebraica et christiana invenitur.

in_english.name: Liorahel
in_english.meaning: God is my light, Lord is my king
in_english.long_meaning: The name Liorahel is of Hebrew origin, meaning 'God is my light' or 'The Lord is my king'. It is derived from 'Lior', meaning light, and 'Ahel', meaning God. This name is used within Jewish and Christian communities, reflecting a connection to divine guidance and kingship. Historically, the elements of the name have biblical roots, emphasizing spiritual illumination and sovereignty.

In Christian tradition, it is believed that Saint Liorahel, a monk and hermit, lived in the 6th century in the region of Palestine. He was known for his devotion to God and his miraculous ability to heal the sick. The name Liorahel is a fusion of the holy lion, symbolizing strength and courage, and the God of Light, symbolizing illumination and wisdom.

Another legend associates the name Liorahel with the 13th century Spanish saint, Peter of Alcantara. He was a Carmelite friar and founder of the Order of the Blessed Virgin Mary of Mount Carmel. The name Liorahel is believed to be a derivative of 'Leo' (lion) and 'Rahab' (God), symbolizing strength in God and deliverance from challenges. Peter of Alcantara was known for his austerity, penance, and miraculous deeds.
